brief: शादी की फिल्म का 30 सेकंड का टीज़र चाहिए, बहुत इमोशनल
concept: Not the wedding: the five seconds before each of them walks in, when nobody is watching.
plan_outline: 1. CU · eye · static · bride's room, window light · the bride's hands, mehndi, holding her mother's hand (3 s)
2. MCU · eye · push in · same room · her mother adjusts her dupatta, eyes wet (4 s)
3. MCU · eye · static · groom's room, warm lamp · the groom's father ties his safa, both silent (4 s)
4. ECU · eye · static · corridor · marigold petals on the floor, feet in juttis stepping through (3 s)
5. WS · eye · track · the mandap, evening, fairy lights · the bride walks in, soft focus crowd (5 s)
6. CU · eye · static · the groom · he sees her; a held breath (4 s)
7. End card (page, Devanagari) · the couple's names and date as the user gives them (3 s)
why: The emotional angle (the private moments before) makes a teaser feel like a story, not a highlight reel.
Close, intimate sizes with parents; the crowd stays soft so no faces merge.
Real people's faces need the couple's own photos as references; without them, keep faces soft or from behind.
